$meta.toneStyle: traditional tone placement used consistently in UI copy: hòa, thủy, khỏe, hủy, tùy
$meta.format: ICU MessageFormat-style {placeholders}. Vietnamese has no plural forms, so counts are interpolated directly; en strings may be wrapped with ICU plural at integration time.

voice.gift.*: sender voice to recipient: resolves {self}/{Self}/{you}/{You}/{we}/{We}/{nha} from pronouns + tone
voice.gift.report, gift.removeMyPhoto, gift.up: app voice (neutral; shown to the recipient by the product, not by the sender)
voice.create.*, booth.*, pay.*, privacy.*, ina: app voice addressing the user as "bạn"; booth is self-use so no sender pronouns
voice.create.share.message, create.message.sug: sender voice (prefilled text the sender can edit)

$meta.case: Keys under booth.pill.*, gift.pill.* and gift.label.* are diegetic status pills and hand labels: written lowercase in the source (never lowercased at runtime, which would also lowercase names). Everything else (buttons, errors, legal, aria) is sentence case. CSS text-transform is banned on Vietnamese.
$meta.placeholderRules: Capitalised placeholder ({Self}, {You}, {We}) is used only at sentence start. Never capitalise by CSS text-transform; use the provided capitalised value. Names ({recipientName}, {senderName}) are inserted verbatim after NFC normalisation; never upper-case them.

none.label: create.pronouns.none
none.note: Uses the recipient's name in place of "you"; resolve {recipientName} after pronoun substitution.
